turns.replyTail:
shop

How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
To get the best result from your braided rug, place a quality non-skid rug pad underneath to prevent slipping, protect your floors, and ensure even wear.
When you first get it, unroll it and let it lay flat for 36 to 48 hours so it relaxes naturally. For regular cleaning, vacuum using suction only without a beater bar, and always trim loose threads instead of pulling them.
